subject: Re: Deployment-mode migration: hosted vs dedicated vs private — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@luminalabs.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@luminalabs.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Deployment-mode migration: hosted vs dedicated vs private — recap and next steps

Hi Alex / Priya,

Great to meet you both this morning — appreciate the walkthrough of Lumina's ingestion pipeline and current latency targets. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we can get you a recommendation for which deployment mode makes sense: Hosted API, Dedicated, or Private (VPC/on-prem).

Recap:
- Current setup: mixed usage — low-volume bursty requests from product experiments + steady batch embedding jobs running on legacy GPU cluster for nightly batch scoring.
- Primary goals: reduce per-token cost for chat features, keep p95 inference latency under 250ms for interactive product, and meet data residency requirements for EU customers in the next quarter.
- Constraints: internal procurement requires an annual contract for reserved capacity if choosing Dedicated; security team prefers VPC for any PII processing workflows.

Suggested next steps:
1) I'll share a short migration playbook and our dedicated pricing PDF (attached) — outlines tradeoffs and timelines per mode.
2) Can you confirm rough monthly PD (peak daily) token volumes for the chat feature and nightly batch size? That will let us model cost across Hosted vs Dedicated.
3) If you expect strict VPC-only for production, we should schedule a security questionnaire kickoff next week — Rishi (SE) can join for the network/KMS discussion.

If you want, we can also run a short spike (2–4 days) on Redwood Hosted to compare latency/cost vs your current cluster; that often accelerates the decision.

Proposed times for the follow-up: Tue 9/16 9am PT or Wed 9/17 11am PT.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-dedicated-pricing.pdf
Attachment: lumina-migration-playbook-v1.docx

From: Alex Johnson <alex@luminalabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@luminalabs.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deployment-mode migration: hosted vs dedicated vs private — recap and next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Monthly volume: currently ~120M prompt tokens + 450M embedding tokens (nightly scoring) — spikes up to ~2x on marketing days.
- Latency: interactive product needs p95 < 250ms for text-gen; batch embeddings aren't latency sensitive but cost-sensitive.
- Data residency: EU for a subset of customers (about 20% of traffic) — would prefer VPC or region-locked Hosted if possible.
- Procurement: we'll likely prefer Dedicated if the unit economics show >30% savings vs Hosted.

We'd be interested in the 2–4 day spike on Hosted to compare. Wed 9/17 11am PT works for the follow-up. Can Rishi join the security bit?

Best,
Alex
Product Ops | Lumina Labs
alex@luminalabs.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@luminalabs.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@luminalabs.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-14T13:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deployment-mode migration: hosted vs dedicated vs private — recap and next steps

Perfect, thanks for the numbers, Alex — that's exactly what we needed. Looping in Rishi (Solutions Engineering) and Dylan (Infrastructure) to scope the Hosted spike and capture any security/VPC constraints up-front.

Rishi / Dylan — quick notes from Lumina:
- 120M prompt tokens & ~450M embedding tokens monthly (bursty spikes ~2x)
- p95 target < 250ms for text-gen; embeddings batch jobs are tolerant but cost-sensitive
- EU residency for ~20% of traffic; procurement favorites Dedicated if economics align

Requests:
- Rishi: can you confirm if a Hosted spike can be pinned to eu-west-1 to validate residency and latency? If Hosted can't fully satisfy residency, we'll document the Dedicated/Private timelines.
- Dylan: please prepare a rough Dedicated sizing (gpus, expected throughput) and a back-of-envelope monthly cost so we can compare against Hosted in the follow-up.

Action: I'll schedule the Wed 9/17 11am PT follow-up and share a calendar invite with a short agenda (spike plan + procurement timeline).

Thanks — Marissa
